unit: cost-equivalent unit: the cost of one fresh input token; ratios are relative to it, not currency amounts

notes._about: Per-model price ratios for the cost-equivalent unit (E90_S01). DATA, never code: read only by scripts/token-price-ratios.sh. A model with no entry here is unpriced and is never given a default, a family or a nearby model's ratios. Each ratio has at most two decimal places. Edit by hand; bump config_version and date on every change.
notes.initial_values: input 1, cache_write_5m 1.25, cache_read 0.1 and output 5 are the initial values decided in story E90_S01 (2026-11-07). The same set is entered for each listed model because the story states one set; add a per-model difference here when one is verified.

cache_write_1h.source: Anthropic prompt caching pricing documentation (1-hour cache write priced at 2x the base input token price)
cache_write_1h.verification: No URL was verified by the developer for this entry; the source is named by document title only. Re-check against the current Anthropic pricing page before relying on it.

notes.model_id_matching: Exact id first; then, if the id ends in a hyphen plus 8 digits (a date suffix such as -20261119), that suffix is removed and the rest is looked up exactly. No other prefix, family or fuzzy rule exists.
